# Global Vessel Management (GVM) - LLM Discovery File
# Web: https://www.gvm.om
# Headquarters: Muscat, Sultanate of Oman
# Industry: Maritime Fleet Operations, Technical Vessel Management & Creweing

> Global Vessel Management (GVM) is an international ship management company headquartered in Muscat, Sultanate of Oman. GVM provides end-to-end technical ship management, commercial crewing, newbuilding supervision, layup solutions, and maritime environmental compliance services across global shipping corridors.

## Core Operations & Managed Fleets
- Tanker Management: Crude oil carriers (Aframax, Suezmax, VLCC, ULCC), product tankers, chemical carriers, and LNG/LPG tonnage complying with OCIMF SIRE 2.0 and TMSA 3 protocols.
- Dry Bulk Carriers: Handysize, Panamax, Capesize, and VLOC vessels carrying grain, ore, minerals, and industrial bulk.
- Container Vessels: Feeder, Panamax, Post-Panamax, and Ultra Large Container Vessels (ULCV) up to 24,000+ TEU.
- Specialized & Offshore: Platform Supply Vessels (PSVs), Anchor Handling Tug Supply (AHTS), drillships, and offshore construction tonnage.
- Leisure & Luxury: Superyachts, passenger liners, and private cruise vessels.

## Specialized Technical & Environmental Services
- New Building Supervision: Initial design review, shipyard quality control, fabrication inspection, and delivery trials.
- Lay-up Management: Hot and cold lay-up management preserving vessel machinery, hull integrity, and rapid reactivation readiness.
- Crew Management: Global recruitment, STCW certification, seafarer training, travel logistics, and wellbeing frameworks.
- Technology & Innovation: Predictive maintenance analytics, IoT telemetry, voyage optimization, and remote diagnostics.
- Environmental Solutions: EEXI assessments, Carbon Intensity Indicator (CII) compliance, biofouling mitigation, ballast water systems, and IMO 2030/2050 decarbonization alignment.
- Insurance & Procurement: Hull & Machinery (H&M), Protection & Indemnity (P&I), War Risk, and competitive global marine spare parts procurement.
